sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown (📊): added "Event info - Type" and "Event info - Country" sections for the recording-listing pageTypes' own `eventParts()` synthetic "Event-Type"/"Event-Country" columns (split from a recording's Comment cell). Neither of eventParts' nine Event-* synthetic columns fed any dropdown section before this — see org/column-unique-value-drop-down-menu.org's "Analysis results" suggestion #1. "Event-Type" offers one entry per distinct value from eventParts' fixed EVENT_TYPE_KEYWORDS vocabulary (live/soundcheck/studio/interview/audition/live rehearsal); "Event-Country" offers one entry per distinct country value, covering both the extractor's USA/Canada/UK branch and its Right-to-Left fallback branch. New: `isEventTypeCol`/`isEventCountryCol` column-name gates, `eventTypeValueCounts`/`eventCountryValueCounts` Maps (added to the `_uniqDropDataCache` bundle), `eventtype:`/`eventcountry:` compound structure-modes in `_cellMatchesStructureMode()`, and `_highlightEventTypeMatch()`/`_highlightEventCountryMatch()`.
